stemMd: If a parcel is express, it has a tracking code. Parcel J has a tracking code. Which conclusion is justified by these facts alone?

options.label: C
options.textMd: J may or may not be express.

options.label: D
options.textMd: No ordinary parcel can be tracked.

explanationMd: Having a tracking code is necessary for being express under the rule, but is not stated to be sufficient. Both express and nonexpress tracked parcels are compatible with it.

distractorRationale.e: Only the opposite inclusion is given.
distractorRationale.d: The rule does not exclude tracking for other parcels.
distractorRationale.b: Express parcels can have tracking codes.
